---
name: Capability parent
about: Track a product capability through bounded sub-issues and acceptance evidence
labels: epic
---

## Capability
Describe the intended product behavior and link the corresponding pre-1.0 requirement.

## Current evidence and gaps
Distinguish implemented internal milestones from producer/native/shipping qualification.
Link already-integrated work rather than recreate it.

## Shipping acceptance
Define the executed evidence required to close this parent. Completing all initial
children alone is not sufficient unless the parent's own criterion is met.

## Decomposition
Add bounded native sub-issues as their scope and dependencies become understood.
Do not assign the entire capability as one oversized implementation task.

## Approvals and boundaries
Each child requires its own relevant specification, plan and execution approvals.
No downloads, target access, probes, permission changes or publication are authorized
by this parent. Start in **Backlog**; do not infer progress percentages from unknown totals.

Authority: [design decisions](https://github.com/landroval/PackTrace/blob/development/docs/design-decisions.md)
and [shipping checklist](https://github.com/landroval/PackTrace/blob/development/docs/pre-1.0-features.md).
